title: Exact restriction/pullback factorization through localization counits
statement: For a prime ℓ, normed field E over ℚ_ℓ and scheme map f:X→Y, let N be any homotopy complex of residue coefficient modules on Y, with the functors of [new-integral-residue-pull-square-data]. The exact restriction/pullback isomorphism at Qh N followed by restriction of the residue pullback counit and the restriction localization factor equals integral derived pullback of the Y restriction factor followed by the integral pullback counit and Qh of the inverse ordinary restriction/pullback isomorphism.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15; derived mate comparison after the flatness clause

proof.text: For each exact composite, expand its derived-composition isomorphism. The factorization equations of mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso identify its Qh factor with Qh of the ordinary square. Transport the two exact functors to their left derived functors using leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory_hom_fac; naturality and cancellation of the iso components give the stated formula. Specialize to integral and residue pullback and coefficient restriction, with comapUpperStarIso as the ordinary square.

theorem restrict_pull_fac {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (N : HomotopyCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) Y))
      (.up ℤ)) :
    (residueExchangeRestrictPullIso ℓ E f).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj N) ≫
      (residueExchangeRestriction ℓ E X).map
        ((residueExchangeUpperStarCounit
          (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) f).app N) ≫
      (Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) X)).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app
        ((((f)^*⟦Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)⟧).mapHomotopyCategory
          (.up ℤ)).obj N) =
      (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).map
        ((Mod.comap
          (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) Y)).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app N) ≫
        (residueExchangeUpperStarCounit (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).app
          (((Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) Y)).mapHomotopyCategory
            (.up ℤ)).obj N) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map
          ((NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory
            (comapUpperStarIso (integralReductionMap ℓ E) f).inv (.up ℤ)).app N)
